action.new_text:
# Validate inputs
    inputs = [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]
    names = ["logp_with_result", "logp_call_only", "logp_no_call"]
    for name, arr in zip(names, inputs):
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if np.any(np.isnan(arr)) or np.any(np.isinf(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    # Shape consistency
    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    # tau_filter validation
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)) or np.isnan(tau_filter) or np.isinf(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number and not boolean")
    n, T = shape
    # Compute normalized decreasing weights
    t = np.arange(T)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()
    # Compute margins
    max_other = np.maximum(logp_call_only, logp_no_call)
    differences = logp_with_result - max_other
    margins = np.dot(differences, weights)
    # Keep mask
    keep = margins > tau_filter
    return (keep, margins)
